evidence: Workbook #25: 'Every dimension prompt sends the judge into the live app via the browser tool - not scoring from source, memory, or a first-paint guess.' Skill quality-checks.md:109 'every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool'; :110 defect = prompt satisfiable from source, memory or first paint. All five prompts line 1 (render, constraints, functional, polish, visual): 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright. ... Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' Functional line 1 adds 'No shell. Use restart_app only once, at the end of protocol D.' All five judge.toml declare [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright' command='playwright-mcp' --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium (line 8-12); functional also wires the 'verifier' restart server (lines 14-18). app_context.md:4 URL http://localhost:3000 matches test.sh PORT=3000. Not first-paint: render gate (render/prompt.md:9, judge.toml:23) requires an incorrect-password refusal then a valid sign-in to a usable workspace, 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'. Constraints gate (prompt.md:9, judge.toml:23) requires a UI-created job+candidate read back by Aud in a new independent browser context. Functional/polish/visual each carry the in-dimension gate (functional:11, polish:11, visual:11) with write + independent-context readback, 'A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails'. Visual (visual/prompt.md:14) mandates a read-only tour of Board, open card details, Conversations with Noor's long conversation, Activity, and Noor's candidate view in an independent context - not a first-paint screenshot. Polish criteria require live concurrent observation (activeElement, scroll offsets, 15s waits, route abort). Functional protocols Z..D are all browser actions or replays of requests 'the UI was seen to use' via page.evaluate/context request (functional:17), still inside the browser tool, and restart via restart_app then re-sign-in (functional:51). Nothing scores from memory: every prompt says to use own new suffixed records and 'never rely on starting counts' (functional:15, polish:14); app_context.md:33-34 forbids assuming reference routes/selectors. Every prompt has the missing-evidence clause (binary0 / Likert1 'NOT EXERCISED - evaluator/tool limitation'), so an unexercised browser gives no credit rather than a guess. Stronger than template (template opens 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP. Use only rendered browser behavior.'). Weak-app probe: a static shell or screenshot-like first paint fails the render gate (needs real sign-in refusal/acceptance) and the shared gate (independent-context readback), zeroing all scored dims. A source-only judge reading is forbidden explicitly. Conforming-alternative probe: an app with different routes, websocket sends or tab-scoped sessions is accommodated ('Discover routes and controls by intent', 'if sends do not use an ordinary request ... setOffline', 'if sessions are per tab'), so no prompt forces a non-browser assumption. Runtime: raw-evidence-index scope states full configured grading is absent; its 6 artifacts (workspace.cjs, workspace.json, server.log, 3 PNGs) hash-match but are a scripted golden driver, not judge transcripts, so actual judge browser use is NOT EXERCISED. That does not alter this prompt-design row; tool-name feasibility of 'browser_run_code_unsafe' in @playwright/mcp 0.0.79 was not verifiable offline here (prompts offer 'A supported separate-context tool is an alternative') and belongs to the tool-feasibility/launch rows.
